(Testing infra note, not a bug) conftest.py autouse fixture monkey-patches requests.Session.request to auto-inject the owner Bearer token on all mutating requests targeting BASE_URL. Anon-403 tests via `requests.Session()` are therefore silently authenticated and always get 200. Options: (a) opt-out via header sentinel like 'X-Skip-Auth-Inject: 1', or (b) let tests bypass via urllib/http.client as done in iter27. Non-blocking but worth a short docstring note in conftest.

(Nice-to-have) The STRATEGY_DISABLED gate at trading_engine.py:863 fires only after the Hunter would return BUY, so an HTTP integration test on POST /api/cycle/run/{symbol} needs a symbol/state that actually triggers a BUY to observe the reason string. The pure gate function is unit-tested in test_strategy_gate.py (5 tests) which is fine; a synthetic evaluate_symbol harness (with a stubbed hunter setup) would let us assert the STRATEGY_DISABLED reason end-to-end in future iterations.

(Nice-to-have) `settings` tab reuses page-question 'Does my strategy actually work?' even though the tab label is 'Research Lab' — copy is fine, but if the tab is ever repurposed to true settings, the question line should track.
critical_code_review_comments: trading_engine.strategy_entry_allowed correctly defaults to True when no meta row exists (backwards-compatible), and treats both 'DISABLED' and 'ERROR' as blocking + honors enabled=False. Called at 3 places in evaluate_symbol (hunter L863, squeeze L1244, continuation L1332) — full coverage of new-entry sites. Exit-engine path is NOT gated, so open positions still get managed (documented intent).

server.PUT /api/strategy/{key}/state validates status against the exact 6-status set, returns 400 for empty body, 404 for unknown key, upserts by key. Depends(require_owner) enforces owner-gate — verified via urllib (403 anon, 200 authed).

server._compute_strategy_metrics computes health as int(round(mean(component_scores))) with 5 baseline components + optional 'consistency' when >=3 return_pct samples exist. Hunter has 6 components (baseline+consistency); squeeze/continuation have 5. Math verified live: hunter breakdown [30,49,30,0,50,60] mean 36.5 -> round 36 == UI display. Timeline lifecycle events are deterministic and include the four required milestones plus optional Last Optimized + Latest Trade.

StrategyCenter.jsx HealthCard renders radial gauge + component bars keyed on `c.key` (data-testid=health-comp-<key>) with color scale + title tooltip carrying the breakdown detail — good UX, transparent scoring. TimelinePanel renders every event with a done/open circle + optional timestamp, matching the backend schema.
AppShell.ContextInfo renders <div data-testid='page-question'> on all 5 tabs (dashboard/portfolio/strategies/reports/settings) with cyan/70 accent — the 'one question per page' framing is consistent.
